maddeler.e:
أنخدع (form VII)
# أَنْخَدِعُ (ʔanḵadiʕu) /ʔan.xa.di.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
# أَنْخَدِعَ (ʔanḵadiʕa) /ʔan.xa.di.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
# أَنْخَدِعْ (ʔanḵadiʕ) /ʔan.xa.diʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
